newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves through overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves through overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system on Monday through overnight system repurchase agreements, a New York Fed spokeswoman said.
Analysts had predicted Fed action this session, but via three-day system RPs.
Fed funds were at 5-5/16 percent at the time of the Fed's operation, falling from 5-3/8 percent shortly before the Fed added reserves.
Funds are seen declining further Monday as Social Security money enters the system, analysts said.
